notes: This file is the single source of truth for everything a role IS: how it reads,
what it may do, and what it is allowed to know. Behaviour lives in js/roles/<id>.js;
that module is validated against this entry at load time, so the two cannot drift.
The game is house-first: a player picks a HOUSE and is then offered the actions
their role can perform there, given who lives there and what has already happened
tonight. So every action carries a `houses` selector (which doors it lights up)
rather than a flat list of legal targets.

village.name: Village
village.goal: Eliminate every werewolf and every cult member.
village.description: The many, the uncoordinated, and the only side that has to work out who it is.

werewolf.name: Werewolves
werewolf.goal: Equal or outnumber the village with no cult left standing.
werewolf.description: They know each other from the first night, and they kill by agreement.

cult.name: The Cult
cult.goal: Hold as many living souls as every other side combined.
cult.description: Grows by conversion rather than killing, which makes it slow and then sudden.

solo.name: Solo
solo.goal: Varies. Each solo role carries its own private victory.
solo.description: Wins alone, on its own terms, usually at everyone else's expense.

supernatural.name: Supernatural
supernatural.description: Reads as uncanny to anything that can sense it.

animal.name: Animal
animal.description: Cannot speak in words during the day.

houseSelectors.any: Every house in the village, occupied or empty, living or dead.
houseSelectors.living-others: Houses of living players, except your own.
houseSelectors.living-any: Houses of living players, your own included.
houseSelectors.living-not-last: Living players, except the one you chose last night.
houseSelectors.dead-wolves: Dead players who were on the werewolf team.
houseSelectors.dead-pets: Dead Cats and Dogs who have not been treated before.
houseSelectors.dead-tonight: Houses whose occupant died during the current night.
houseSelectors.living-non-cult: Living players not already on the cult team.
houseSelectors.living-cult: Living players on the cult team.
houseSelectors.living-non-wolf: Living players not on the werewolf team.

chargeModes.used: The player field counts actions SPENT; charges left is `charges` minus it. The default.
chargeModes.remaining: The player field IS the number left, and counts down to zero.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.description: Chooses a player to kill each night.
roles.lore: The pack does not argue for long. Whichever door most of them are howling at is the one that opens.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Every house marked by the Wolf Shaman
Deaths the Shaman hid from the village

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Cast your vote for tonight's kill. The pack's votes are tallied when the night closes; the Alpha's howl counts twice.

passives.name: Pack Sight
passives.description: You see your fellow wolves and their votes as they land.

passives.name: Bad Meat
passives.description: If the pack kills a Diseased villager, the wolf who called the kill dies with them.

roles.name: Alpha Wolf
roles.tagline: Turns the village into the pack.
roles.description: Infects a player. After two nights, they become a werewolf.
roles.lore: Killing is loud. The Alpha prefers a bite that nobody notices until the moon is right.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Who you have infected and how long they have left

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Your howl carries: it counts as two votes in the pack's tally.

actions.label: Infect
actions.houseVerb: Slip inside and bite them in their sleep
actions.description: The victim keeps their role and their memories for two more nights, and then wakes up as a werewolf. They are told nothing until it happens.

passives.name: Double Howl
passives.description: Your vote for the night's kill is worth two.

roles.name: Wolf Shaman
roles.description: Marks a house. If the pack kills the player who lives there, no body is ever found.
roles.lore: A village that finds no body finds no story either. It just finds someone missing, and starts guessing.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Every death you have hidden

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Cast your vote for tonight's kill.

actions.label: Mark for silence
actions.houseVerb: Draw the silencing sign on this door
actions.description: You may hold only one mark at a time; marking a new house releases the old one. If the pack kills the marked player, the village is told nothing at all — but the pack, and only the pack, sees who is gone.

passives.name: Unburied
passives.description: A marked victim of the pack leaves no body, no announcement, and no role reveal.

roles.name: Albularyo
roles.description: Wolf-team folk healer who can bring one dead wolf back, once per game.
roles.lore: Herbs, salt, a whispered name. It only ever works on one of their own, and only once.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Cast your vote for tonight's kill.

actions.label: Call them back
actions.houseVerb: Sit with the body and begin the rites
actions.description: A dead wolf wakes immediately and may act again the same night. The village is never told.

passives.name: Quiet Work
passives.description: Your revival is never announced in the morning.

roles.name: Villager
roles.description: Works through the night at small tasks, and earns their way to something better.
roles.lore: Nobody hands a villager a title. They stay up, do the work, and one morning the village finds it needs them for something.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Who the Mayor is, once a Mayor exists

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: A short puzzle — a sequence, a pattern, a memory run, a reaction test. Score enough across the game and the village promotes you into a real role.

passives.name: Promotion
passives.description: Reach 1000 points of night work and you are quietly given a village role in its place.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: Learns the role of one player each night.
roles.lore: The hardest part is not the seeing. It is being believed before the pack decides you are worth a visit.
roles.winCondition: Help the village eliminate every werewolf.
knows: The true role of anyone you read, subject to disguises

actions.label: Read them
actions.houseVerb: Look through the window and read what is inside
actions.description: You learn their role at once. A Lycan reads as a Werewolf; a Trickster reads as whoever they last copied.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.tagline: Stands between a knife and a neck.
roles.description: Protects one player from death each night — but never the same player twice in a row.
roles.lore: You do not get told whether you were needed. Some nights that is a mercy.
roles.winCondition: Keep the village alive long enough to win it.
knows: Whether your patient was attacked while you were there

actions.label: Keep watch
actions.houseVerb: Sit up with them through the night
actions.description: Any lethal attack on this house from the moment you arrive is turned away. An attack that already landed tonight is not — you will find the body instead.

passives.name: Rounds
passives.description: You cannot guard the same house two nights running.

roles.name: Bodyguard
roles.description: Guards a player and dies in their place if the blow lands.
roles.lore: The Doctor turns the blade aside. The Bodyguard is what is standing where the blade was going.
roles.winCondition: Protect the people who matter and eliminate the wolves.
knows: Whether anyone came for your charge tonight

actions.label: Guard this house
actions.houseVerb: Stand at the door all night
actions.description: The first lethal attack after you arrive kills you instead. Arrive after the killing and you find your charge already dead.

roles.name: Detective
roles.description: Learns where a player went last night, and who came to see them.
roles.lore: Roles lie. Movement does not.
roles.winCondition: Work out who is hunting, and get the village to listen.
knows: Last night's comings and goings at any one house

actions.label: Read the tracks
actions.houseVerb: Study the mud on the step
actions.description: You learn which house this player visited last night and how many people came to theirs — names, not roles.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.tagline: Sets a bell, not a blade.
roles.description: Rigs a house so that anyone who visits it is named.
roles.lore: Wire, a latch, and a tin can. It has caught more wolves than the Seer has.
roles.winCondition: Catch the traffic and hand the village a name.
knows: Everyone who entered your trapped house tonight, in order

actions.label: Set the trap
actions.houseVerb: Rig the doorway
actions.description: For the rest of the night, every visitor to this house is reported to you by name, as they arrive. The trap is spent at dawn.

roles.name: Avenger
roles.description: Names a player. If the Avenger dies, that player dies too.
roles.lore: Point at whoever you would take with you. Hope you are pointing at the right door.
roles.winCondition: Take a wolf down with you.

actions.label: Swear revenge
actions.houseVerb: Swear that if you fall, this house falls with you
actions.description: Re-swearable every night. If you die by any cause while the oath stands, they die immediately after you.

passives.name: Last Word
passives.description: Your revenge fires whether you were killed at night or hanged at noon.

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: Holds a saving potion and a killing potion. Each may be used once, ever.
roles.lore: Both bottles look the same in the dark, which is the only reason she has ever been careful.
roles.winCondition: Villager-aligned. Spend the bottles well.

actions.label: Save
actions.houseVerb: Pour the clear bottle at their threshold
actions.description: Turns aside any lethal attack that arrives after you do. Once per game.

actions.label: Poison
actions.houseVerb: Pour the dark bottle at their threshold
actions.description: Kills at once, through most protections that were not already in place. Once per game.

roles.name: Mason
roles.description: Knows every other Mason from the first night.
roles.lore: Two people who are certain of each other are worth more than either one of them knowing a secret.
roles.winCondition: Build the trust the village votes on.
knows: Every other living Mason

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: Masons have no night power beyond knowing each other.

passives.name: Brotherhood
passives.description: You and the other Masons see one another every night.

roles.name: Mayor
roles.description: Every villager knows who the Mayor is. So does everybody else.
roles.lore: A known honest voice is the most useful thing the village has and the first thing the pack removes.
roles.winCondition: Lead the village to victory.

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: The Mayor's power is entirely daylight.

passives.name: Known Face
passives.description: Your role is shown to every village-team player, and is an assassination target.

roles.name: Lycan
roles.description: A villager who appears as a Werewolf to anyone who reads them.
roles.lore: Something in the blood. Not enough to howl with, more than enough to hang for.
roles.winCondition: Villager-aligned, and good luck proving it.
knows: That you will be read as a Werewolf

passives.name: False Scent
passives.description: The Seer, the Assassin's stalking and every other reader see a Werewolf.

roles.name: Diseased
roles.description: The wolf who kills this player dies of it.
roles.lore: You will not survive the night. Neither will whoever came through the window.
roles.winCondition: If the wolves take you, they lose one of their own.

passives.name: Bad Meat
passives.description: A werewolf kill on you kills the wolf that carried it out.

roles.name: Doppelgänger
roles.description: Copies another player's role once per game, and keeps it.
roles.lore: Not a disguise. You stop being what you were.
roles.winCondition: You win with whichever team you end up on.
knows: The role you copied, from the moment you take it

actions.label: Become them
actions.houseVerb: Study them until you are them
actions.description: You take their role — and their team — for the rest of the game. They keep theirs. Once per game, and there is no going back.

roles.name: Trickster
roles.description: Takes on the appearance of another player's role for investigators.
roles.lore: The Seer is only ever as reliable as the night the Trickster picked.
roles.winCondition: Survive to the end with the village.
knows: The role view of whoever you last copied

actions.label: Wear their face
actions.houseVerb: Take on the shape of this house
actions.description: Every reader now sees you as their role, and you see the world through that role's eyes until you change again.

passives.name: Worn Face
passives.description: Investigation results on you return the copied role, not yours.

roles.name: Naughty Boy
roles.description: Swaps the roles of two players. Once per game.
roles.lore: Neither of them is told. That is the whole joke.
roles.winCondition: Cause chaos and survive it with the village.
knows: Both roles you swapped

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Pick this house as one half of a swap
actions.description: Choose a second house to complete the swap. The two players exchange roles at once and are told nothing.

roles.name: Crazy Naughty Boy
roles.description: Swaps the roles of two players. Every single night.
roles.lore: By the fourth night nobody in the village is who they say they are, and half of them are right about it.
roles.winCondition: Maximum chaos, village victory.
knows: Both roles in every swap you make

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Pick this house as one half of a swap
actions.description: Choose a second house to complete the swap. No limit, every night.

roles.name: Naughty Ghost
roles.description: An ordinary villager while alive. After dying, swaps roles every night from beyond the grave.
roles.lore: Killing them is the mistake. They were harmless right up until the funeral.
roles.winCondition: Help the village win, alive or otherwise.
knows: Both roles in every swap you make, once dead

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: While you are alive you are a villager and nothing more.

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Reach through and pick this house
actions.description: Available only after your death. Choose a second house to complete the swap.

passives.name: Restless
passives.description: Death is a promotion. You keep taking night turns after it.

roles.name: Archangel
roles.tagline: Raises the dead, and punishes its killers.
roles.description: Can bring one dead player back with a brand new role. Killing it is expensive.
roles.lore: Whatever is left after the wings come off is only a villager, and the village usually notices too late.
roles.winCondition: Protect the village and eliminate the wolves.

actions.label: Raise them
actions.houseVerb: Kneel at the body and call it back
actions.description: The dead player returns at once, with a new village role of your choosing or one drawn at random — and may take their turn the same night. You may reveal the new role to the village or keep it secret. Once per game.

passives.name: Divine Retribution
passives.description: Killed by the pack: every wolf that howled for you dies. Killed by anyone else: they die instead of you.

passives.name: The Fall
passives.description: Surviving either of those, or being voted out, strips you to an ordinary Villager. Being voted out does not kill you.

roles.name: Diwata
roles.tagline: Kill her and the forest answers.
roles.description: A forest spirit. If the werewolves kill her, every werewolf dies with her.
roles.lore: The trees keep a count. They settle it all at once.
roles.winCondition: Protect the village and eliminate the wolves.

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and hold the ward
actions.description: Her power is entirely passive; the night's work keeps it lit.

passives.name: Forest Curse
passives.description: A werewolf kill on her kills every living werewolf.

passives.name: One Ward
passives.description: The first non-werewolf attempt on her life fails. The second strips her to an ordinary Villager.

roles.name: Vet
roles.description: Brings one dead Cat or Dog back, once per game.
roles.lore: It is not much of a power until the village realises the Cat was the only honest witness it had.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Which pets are dead and still treatable

actions.label: Treat them
actions.houseVerb: Carry them in and work on them
actions.description: The Cat or Dog wakes immediately, keeps its role, and may act again the same night. Each animal can be treated only once, ever.

roles.name: Cat
roles.description: A villager who cannot say a word in daylight, and who bites in the dark.
roles.lore: It knows exactly which house smells wrong. It cannot tell you which one.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your bite met a wolf — by dying of it

actions.label: Bite
actions.houseVerb: Slip in and bite whoever is sleeping there
actions.description: Harmless to everyone except a werewolf. Bite a wolf and you die of it, and the village is told a Cat died biting something. The victim is told they were bitten.

passives.name: Meow
passives.description: During discussion you may send only meows. The room sees them as meows.

roles.name: Dog
roles.description: A villager who cannot say a word in daylight, and who bites in the dark.
roles.lore: Loud, loyal, and completely unable to explain itself.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your bite met a wolf — by dying of it

actions.label: Bite
actions.houseVerb: Slip in and bite whoever is sleeping there
actions.description: Harmless to everyone except a werewolf. Bite a wolf and you die of it. The victim is told they were bitten.

passives.name: Bark
passives.description: During discussion you may send only barks. The room sees them as barks.

roles.name: Pulis
roles.description: Can search a body for clues, or shoot a living suspect. One or the other, each night.
roles.lore: Shoot the right person and the village hands you the whole armoury. Shoot the wrong one and they take the badge.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: What the bodies you search were, and what killed them

actions.label: Search the body
actions.houseVerb: Go over the body for clues
actions.description: You learn the dead player's true role and what killed them. Unlimited, but it is your action for the night.

actions.label: Shoot
actions.houseVerb: Kick the door in
actions.description: Kills at once. Shoot a village-team player and you are stripped to an ordinary Villager on the spot; shoot anyone else and you are cleared for unlimited kills.

passives.name: Accountability
passives.description: Killing an innocent demotes you permanently.

roles.name: Call Center Agent
roles.description: Writes a question with four answers and makes a player answer it before they may act.
roles.lore: Your call is important to us. Please stay on the line while the wolves eat.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your mark answered correctly

actions.label: Put on hold
actions.houseVerb: Ring this house and keep them talking
actions.description: You write the question and mark the right answer. Next night, before they may do anything, they must get it right. Two calls per game.

roles.name: Cult Leader
roles.description: Recruits non-wolf players into the cult. Three attempts per game.
roles.lore: Nobody dies. That is exactly how far along it gets before anyone counts.
roles.winCondition: Hold as many living souls as every other side put together.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Recruit
actions.houseVerb: Knock, and make the offer
actions.description: The target is asked, on their own phone, whether they accept. If they do they become a Cultist immediately and see the rest of the cult. Werewolves cannot be recruited.

passives.name: Succession
passives.description: If you die, every Fanatic is promoted to Fanatic+.

roles.name: Cultist
roles.description: A villager taken by the Cult Leader. Becomes a Fanatic after two nights.
roles.lore: They keep the job, the house and the face. The loyalty is the only part that changed.
roles.winCondition: Help the cult take the village.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and keep up appearances
actions.description: Nothing yet. Two nights of this and you become a Fanatic.

passives.name: Evolution
passives.description: After two nights you become a Fanatic automatically.

roles.name: Fanatic
roles.description: Guards a cult member and dies in their place.
roles.lore: There is no version of this where the Fanatic gets to live and be right.
roles.winCondition: Protect the cult until it is the majority.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Guard
actions.houseVerb: Stand watch at this door
actions.description: The first lethal attack on this cult member after you arrive kills you instead.

roles.name: Fanatic+
roles.description: Saves a cult member from death outright, without dying for it.
roles.lore: Promotion, in a cult, means the last person above you is dead.
roles.winCondition: Lead the cult to victory.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Shield
actions.houseVerb: Ward this door
actions.description: Any lethal attack on this cult member after you arrive is turned away. Not the same member two nights running.

roles.name: Jester
roles.description: Wins the moment the village votes them out.
roles.lore: Every clumsy lie is on purpose. Being obviously guilty of nothing is a very hard trick.
roles.winCondition: Get yourself eliminated by the village vote.

actions.label: Look busy
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and do something incriminating
actions.description: You are given a deliberately suspicious errand each night. It does nothing. That is the point.

passives.name: Last Laugh
passives.description: Being voted out ends the game in your favour immediately. Dying at night does not.

roles.name: Assassin
roles.description: Learns roles slowly, and kills by naming one correctly.
roles.lore: Wrong guess, wrong throat. The knife does not care whose it is.
roles.winCondition: Kill every team leader — Alpha Wolf, Cult Leader, Mayor and Seer.
knows: Which leaders are still alive
Every role you have stalked, one night late

actions.label: Stalk
actions.houseVerb: Watch this house from the dark
actions.description: You learn their role — but not until your next turn. Unlimited.

actions.label: Assassinate
actions.houseVerb: Go in with the knife and a name
actions.description: Name the role you believe they hold. Right, and they die at once. Wrong, and you do. Charges equal the number of leaders in the game.

roles.name: Manipulator
roles.tagline: Sees everything, does nothing, wins anyway.
roles.description: Knows every role in the game, and steals the victory of whichever side wins — as long as they are alive to take it.
roles.lore: They never lifted a finger, and the whole village worked for them.
roles.winCondition: Be alive when anyone else wins. Then it is yours instead.
knows: Every player's true role, every night

actions.label: Watch the board
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and read the room
actions.description: The full role list is in front of you. There is nothing to do but stay alive.

passives.name: Omniscience
passives.description: You see every player's true role.

passives.name: Theft
passives.description: Any side's victory becomes yours instead, provided you are alive. Dead, you win nothing.

universalActions.label: Report the body
universalActions.description: Offered at any house whose occupant died tonight. The village is told at dawn who found them — including if the finder was the killer. Reporting does not spend your turn.

universalActions.label: Look inside
universalActions.description: Walk up to any house and see what is on offer there. Costs nothing and is never recorded as a visit until you actually do something.

universalActions.label: Stay home
universalActions.houseVerb: Bolt the door and wait for morning
